Why It Matters

Most beginners lose their first deposit. Not because they are unlucky, but because they are unprepared.

Trade Too Early

Most beginners lose money simply because they trade too early, driven by hype and emotion.

No Tactical Practice

Chess masters solve thousands of puzzles, to prepare for games. Traders need the same focused practice on specific patterns.

Unrealistic Simulators

Traditional paper trading takes a lot of time and is unstructured. That's why only few make it to the end.

Am I ready?

There's no way to know if you're ready - until you lose real money.

What TradingPrep Offers

An interactive gym to build your chart-reading muscle memory, safely and effectively.

Endless Practice

Practice on thousands of chart examples: grouped by topic or mixed. Nail your preparation.

Instant Feedback

Choose Long / Short / Skip and get instant feedback on your decision, with a clear explanation.

Track Your Progress

Monitor your accuracy, identify your weak spots, track your progress over time. Numbers don't lie - get an objective skill assessment.

Our Mission: your success.
Learn. Test yourself. Decide. If you’re ready, trade responsibly. If you’re not, you just saved your account - and that’s a win.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is this free?

Yes, the beta is 100% free. We want to gather feedback and build the best possible training tool with the help of our first users.

Is this real trading?

No, and that's the point. This is a training-only environment. There are no real markets, no deposits, and absolutely no financial risk.

Will this help me make money?

It will help you avoid losing money unnecessarily. Our goal is to help you build skills and decide if you’re ready to even start trading with real capital.

Do I need prior knowledge?

No. The simulator is designed to help you learn as you go. Each decision comes with an explanation, helping you understand the logic behind price action patterns.
